
```{r}
df <- tibble::tribble(
    ~se,
    "FALL",
    "WINTER",
    "SPRING",
    "SUMMER"
)
df
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
df |> mutate(se = str_to_lower(se))
```

```{r}
df |> mutate(se = str_replace(se, "R", "$"))
```

```{r}
df |> mutate(se = str_sub(se, 1, 2))
```

```{r}
df |> mutate(len = str_length(se))
```

```{r}
df |> mutate(there = str_detect(se, "I"))
```

```{r}
df |> tidyr::separate_wider_regex(se, c("p1" = "..", "p2" = ".+"))
```
